rows.text: La revisión previa al viaje se centra primero en el estado visible y los dispositivos de seguridad. La inspección técnica de la inyección requiere procedimientos y conocimientos específicos; no es un control ordinario antes de cada viaje.
evidence: UK DVSA bus and coach walkaround guidance https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — examples of operational safety checks; UK guidance is not Italian law and a checklist is not exhaustive proof of all Italian obligations.

Italian CdS art.79 https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-79/ and art.180 https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-180/ — vehicle efficiency and required documents, within their respective scopes.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO. El filtro de climatización suele atenderse en el mantenimiento programado; las comprobaciones previas se centran principalmente en la seguridad. Sigue el manual y las instrucciones del operador para ese vehículo.
evidence: UK DVSA bus and coach walkaround guidance https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — examples of operational safety checks; UK guidance is not Italian law and a checklist is not exhaustive proof of all Italian obligations.

evidence: UK DVSA bus and coach walkaround guidance https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — examples of operational safety checks; UK guidance is not Italian law and a checklist is not exhaustive proof of all Italian obligations.

Italian CdS art.164(6), https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-164/ — marking required in the specified protruding-load circumstances, not universal bus equipment.

rows.text: Las bebidas pueden formar parte del servicio a pasajeros, pero no son un equipo de seguridad que deba revisarse antes de salir.
evidence: UK DVSA bus and coach walkaround guidance https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — examples of operational safety checks; UK guidance is not Italian law and a checklist is not exhaustive proof of all Italian obligations.

rows.text: Se comprueba el refrigerante frente a las marcas del depósito para que el sistema de enfriamiento del motor funcione correctamente.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/lorry-and-bus-show-me-tell-me-vehicle-safety-questions/lorry-and-bus-show-me-tell-me-vehicle-safety-questions §2.16: coolant level is checked against the reservoir markings.

rows.text: La presión debe ser adecuada para el vehículo: una presión baja o excesiva cambia el contacto del neumático con la calzada.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks §19: tyres must be correctly inflated.

rows.text: Cuando se exige cronotacógrafo, el conductor debe asegurarse de que funcione correctamente para registrar las actividades previstas.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32014R0165 Article 32(1): drivers and undertakings ensure proper functioning and use of tachographs.

rows.text: Los documentos exigidos dependen del vehículo, el conductor y el viaje. Revisarlos antes de salir permite acreditar las autorizaciones y condiciones necesarias durante los controles.
evidence: UK DVSA bus and coach walkaround guidance https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — examples of operational safety checks; UK guidance is not Italian law and a checklist is not exhaustive proof of all Italian obligations.

Italian CdS art.79 https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-79/ and art.180 https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-180/ — vehicle efficiency and required documents, within their respective scopes.

UK guidance https://www.gov.uk/guidance/international-bus-or-coach-services-and-tours-vehicle-documents — journey-specific transport documentation example; UK guidance, not proof of Italian universal list.

rows.text: Hay que revisar el desgaste y los daños de la banda de rodadura, la parte del neumático que se adhiere a la calzada.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks §19: check tread and damage.

rows.text: Los frenos deben funcionar correctamente: la revisión incluye el freno de servicio y el de estacionamiento.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks §6: check service and parking brakes and air build-up.

rows.text: Una revisión visual de la suspensión puede detectar daños evidentes o una posición anormal del vehículo antes del viaje.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/lorry-and-bus-show-me-tell-me-vehicle-safety-questions/lorry-and-bus-show-me-tell-me-vehicle-safety-questions §2.14: check suspension for obvious deterioration or damage before use.

rows.text: Los dispositivos de seguridad deben funcionar: por ejemplo, se revisan las salidas de emergencia y los cinturones instalados.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks §§10, 12, 15–16: check emergency exits, belts and safety equipment.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO: la distancia indicada por sí sola no determina qué repuestos se requieren. Verifica el equipo y el procedimiento ante pinchaduras según el vehículo, la ruta y el operador.
evidence: UK DVSA bus and coach walkaround guidance https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — examples of operational safety checks; UK guidance is not Italian law and a checklist is not exhaustive proof of all Italian obligations.

The quoted DVSA checklist is an operational example, not exhaustive proof of Italian requirements; learner text preserves the printed quiz answer and leaves vehicle, route and operator-specific requirements open.

rows.text: Las cuotas del arrendamiento son una cuestión contractual; antes de salir se revisan la seguridad del vehículo y los documentos exigidos para el viaje.
evidence: UK DVSA bus and coach walkaround guidance https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — examples of operational safety checks; UK guidance is not Italian law and a checklist is not exhaustive proof of all Italian obligations.

rows.text: No es necesario llevar a bordo el certificado de propiedad separado. Para los vehículos inscritos en el PRA, el documento único sustituye los anteriores cuando se emite; hasta entonces estos siguen siendo válidos.
evidence: ACI, Documenti del veicolo https://aci.gov.it/pratica-auto/documenti-del-veicolo-consigli-e-obblighi-di-legge/ — separate ownership certificate need not be carried; previous documents remain valid until DU issued.
MIT https://www.mit.gov.it/node/17026 — DU replaces circulation and ownership documents as issued, with transition.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO. La legibilidad de la publicidad sirve para comunicar el nombre o mensaje de la empresa; es distinta de las comprobaciones de seguridad o identificación del vehículo, como la placa.
evidence: UK DVSA bus and coach walkaround guidance https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — examples of operational safety checks; UK guidance is not Italian law and a checklist is not exhaustive proof of all Italian obligations.

Italian CdS art.79 https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-79/ and art.180 https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-180/ — vehicle efficiency and required documents, within their respective scopes.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO: no hay una regla general que exija neumáticos fabricados hace menos de dos años. Hay que comprobar su estado, desgaste e idoneidad, considerando las normas de edad que correspondan.
evidence: Continental tyre service-life guidance https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-technical-databook.pdf.coredownload.pdf p.117 — service life depends on conditions; manufacturer discusses ten-year replacement recommendation, not a two-year universal cap.
DVSA bus walkaround tyre checks https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — inspect visible condition and wear; UK operational guidance, not Italian law.

rows.text: En la dirección asistida hidráulica debe revisarse periódicamente el nivel: un nivel insuficiente puede afectar la asistencia al giro.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/government/news/the-walkaround-check-a-legal-duty-and-safety-priority: where accessible, check power steering fluid level.

rows.text: El sistema requiere el fluido indicado por el fabricante; el agua no lo sustituye. Si el nivel es muy bajo, hay que identificar la causa y seguir el manual o pedir asistencia.
evidence: Ford Econoline owner guide https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/catalog/owner_guides/96ecoog1e.pdf p.331 — use only fluid meeting manufacturer power-steering specification, model example.

rows.text: Usa solo fluido que cumpla la especificación de la dirección asistida; un aceite lubricante genérico no es automáticamente adecuado. Algunos vehículos exigen un fluido de transmisión concreto: consulta el manual.
evidence: Ford Econoline owner guide https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/catalog/owner_guides/96ecoog1e.pdf p.331 — specified Mercon ATF example; use fluids that meet actual manufacturer requirements.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO: la dirección asistida normalmente proporciona ayuda durante la conducción, sin una palanca universal junto al volante para desactivarla. Las funciones y mandos varían según el vehículo; consulta el manual.
evidence: Haldex Power Steering Troubleshooting https://www.haldex.com/globalassets/north-america/documents/power-steering/l20696 — power-steering system supplies assistance; individual configurations and controls vary. No claim that every vehicle lacks a switch.
Original source asks whether assistance can be disengaged using a lever near the wheel; no assertion that every conceivable vehicle lacks a switch or other control.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca VERDADERO. Sustituir el volante requiere conocimientos y procedimientos adecuados, sobre todo si lleva bolsa de aire. Las fuentes consultadas no establecen que toda sustitución esté legalmente reservada a un taller; acude a personal calificado.
evidence: UK HSE airbag handling https://www.hse.gov.uk/mvr/topics/storing-handling-airbags-seat-belt.htm — airbag-equipped component handling requires proper precautions and competence; does not establish an Italian universal legal workshop monopoly.

rows.text: Un volante más grande no corrige la causa de una dirección dura, que puede deberse a presión o nivel de fluido bajos, o a componentes trabados. Haz revisar el sistema y usa componentes adecuados para el vehículo.
evidence: TRW HF54 service manual https://www.trwaftermarket.com/globalassets/na/trucksteering---literature/steeringgears-lit/steeringgears-sm/hf-54/hf54.pdf — hard steering troubleshooting includes pressure, fluid and mechanical binding; model-specific technical causes.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca VERDADERO, pero el conductor puede hacer controles preliminares, por ejemplo del movimiento, juego y asistencia de la dirección. Una evaluación técnica detallada requiere procedimientos y conocimientos adecuados; no todas las comprobaciones se hacen exclusivamente en un taller.
evidence: DVSA bus and coach daily walkaround checks, steering, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — driver checks movement, assistance and excessive play; UK operational guidance illustrating practical checks, not Italian law.

DVSA inspection manual, steering https://www.gov.uk/guidance/mot-inspection-manual-for-private-passenger-and-light-commercial-vehicles/2-steering — technical assessment and play measurement; UK inspection example.

Italian CdS art.79 https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-79/ — maintenance in efficient and safe condition; does not state that all steering checks are exclusively in a workshop. The distinction between preliminary and full assessment is explanatory; no official quiz intention asserted.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO. Una inspección visual personal puede detectar algunos defectos, pero por sí sola no garantiza una evaluación completa de la dirección. El conductor también puede revisar el movimiento y el juego según el vehículo; las anomalías requieren una revisión técnica.
evidence: DVSA bus and coach daily walkaround checks, steering, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks — driver checks movement, assistance and excessive play; UK operational guidance illustrating practical checks, not Italian law.

DVSA inspection manual, steering https://www.gov.uk/guidance/mot-inspection-manual-for-private-passenger-and-light-commercial-vehicles/2-steering — technical assessment and play measurement; UK inspection example.

Italian CdS art.79 https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-79/ — maintenance in efficient and safe condition; does not state that all steering checks are exclusively in a workshop. The distinction between preliminary and full assessment is explanatory; no official quiz intention asserted.

reviewer_evidence: All 25 original source records and four-language texts inspected. DVSA https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks section 4 directly supports driver checks of steering movement, assist and play; 30817/30818 preserve both visible original answers while distinguishing preliminary and detailed inspection. UK guidance is operational example, not Italian law.

Ford Econoline https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/catalog/owner_guides/96ecoog1e.pdf indexed manufacturer guide describes specified transmission fluid for power-steering reservoir; 30812/30813 distinguish unsuitable generic substitutes from manufacturer-approved fluid. HSE https://www.hse.gov.uk/mvr/topics/storing-handling-airbags-seat-belt.htm supports qualified handling of airbag-equipped wheels; 30815 retains visible limit on unproven universal legal exclusivity.

Italian ACI https://aci.gov.it/pratica-auto/documenti-del-veicolo-consigli-e-obblighi-di-legge/ explicitly states older registration/ownership papers remain valid until DU issued. Its direct vehicle-document guidance says ownership certificate is not required on board. MIT cited longer DU URL timed out; accessible official equivalent https://www.mit.gov.it/node/17026 independently inspected.

Rechecked 30795/30806: quiz-framed explanations leave vehicle, route and operator instructions open rather than claiming an exhaustive legal list. Ford cabin filter product guidance https://www.ford.com/product/cabin-air-filter-p4000042018 provides a manufacturer example of scheduled replacement, with owner-guide specificity; not proof of universal bus intervals. 30808 now correctly preserves validity of pre-DU papers, per ACI/MIT; 30809 addresses advertisements; 30814 directly addresses the proposed disengagement lever, with vehicle-specific qualification. Other rows unchanged from prior full review.

issues.reason: Question asks whether driver can disengage power steering with lever; explanation instead says engaging a lever before each turn is unnecessary. Address actual deactivation claim and retain vehicle-specific qualification.

The unqualified statement that the DU has replaced earlier documents for PRA vehicles omits the transition: earlier registration and ownership documents remain valid until DU issuance. ACI https://aci.gov.it/pratica-auto/documenti-del-veicolo-consigli-e-obblighi-di-legge/ and MIT https://www.mit.gov.it/node/17026 directly confirm. Separate ownership certificate still need not be carried.

Explaining that advertisements do not replace compulsory equipment does not address the question about legibility of the company advertisement. Explain its commercial purpose and why it is not the same as a mandatory safety or identification check, without inventing an exhaustive list of duties.

The claim that drivers need not check cabin filter cleanliness before every journey is categorical, but the only evidence is a non-exhaustive UK daily checklist and general Italian provisions. Qualify as ordinary servicing/quiz framing or provide claim-specific authoritative support; allow vehicle/operator instructions.

The 500-km/two-spares categorical negative is not established by a non-exhaustive UK safety checklist and general Italian legal articles. Qualify the quiz convention and specify that equipment may depend on applicable vehicle/route/operator requirements, or supply directly relevant authoritative source.
